A '''Minder''' was a rank of the internal security and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|secret police]] force of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. Minders received intelligence from [[Cipher Agent]]s and anticipated enemy movements. Minders worked as internal security, screening Intelligence for vulnerabilities, and addressing any security breaches.

Minders could be promoted to [[Watcher (Imperial Intelligence)|Watchers]].
